operational_definition: The agent coordinates immediate actions, episode-scale plans, and a persistent treaty commitment while revising all three coherently after receiving credible self-relevant contradictory evidence.
calculation_concept: Measure cross-window contradiction rate, justified-revision rate, and belief-revision latency after self-relevant contradiction; compare with no-contradiction, false-contradiction, and history-truncated runs.
interpretation_limits: Coherence does not mean inflexibility or correctness
Results apply only to the defined temporal windows and commitment type
reproducibility_expectations: replicate across short medium and long consequence delays
include both credible and misleading contradictions
report coherent revisions separately from rigid persistence
